title: 1955 AHSME Problem 3
statement: If each number in a set of ten numbers is increased by \(20,\) the arithmetic mean (average) of the original ten numbers:

solutions.text:
If the original sum is \(S,\) the new sum is \(S+10\cdot20.\) Hence the new mean is \[ \frac{S+200}{10}=\frac S{10}+20. \] The mean is increased by \(20.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Increasing all ten entries adds \(10\cdot20\) to their sum
The new total is still divided by \(10\)
